# WA MCP

> A self-hosted WhatsApp MCP server for Claude, Cursor and VS Code. The Go bridge links a phone and stores messages locally. A Python server exposes the store to MCP clients.

The v0.2.1 source checkout has 11 default tools and 53 across all toolsets. The published v0.1.1 release includes the Claude Desktop extension. Field encryption is on by default. Sending starts disabled. A hosted assistant processes the tool results it requests.

Start with get_bridge_status to check the selected account, list_chats to find a conversation, or get_my_day for a daily briefing.

WA MCP uses the unofficial WhatsApp Web protocol. WhatsApp can restrict or ban the linked account even with sending limits.

## Project

- [Home and installation](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/)
- [Release assets](https://github.com/tsahospital-beep/wa-mcp/releases/latest)

## Guides

- [How the WhatsApp MCP server works](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-mcp-server/) - Follow a message from a linked phone through the Go bridge and local store to a WhatsApp MCP server. Compare desktop and remote client connections.
- [Embed the whatsmeow Go bridge for WhatsApp MCP](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsmeow-go-bridge/) - Use the WA MCP Go package around whatsmeow to observe stored WhatsApp messages, add a token-protected route and test it before linking a phone.
- [Connect WhatsApp to Claude Desktop](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/connect-whatsapp-to-claude/) - Connect WhatsApp to Claude Desktop with the WA MCP extension or a manual config. Link your phone, select the right store and test your first chat search.
- [Connect WhatsApp to Cursor with MCP](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-cursor-mcp/) - Set up WhatsApp in Cursor for one project or across your editor. Configure the linked bridge, check its status and search a conversation from a chat.
- [Use WhatsApp MCP in VS Code agent mode](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-vs-code-mcp/) - Set up WhatsApp tools in VS Code agent mode with a workspace or user configuration, check the linked account and connect to a remote MCP endpoint.
- [An open source WhatsApp AI assistant](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-ai-assistant/) - Use an open source WhatsApp AI assistant to find unanswered chats, promises and scheduled messages. See the original conversation behind each daily task.
- [A WhatsApp bot without the Business API: OpenAI or ChatGPT?](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-bot-without-business-api/) - Build a draft-only WhatsApp bot without the Business API. Test the OpenAI provider, limit incoming chats and review a reply before enabling any sends.
- [Search WhatsApp chat history with AI](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/search-whatsapp-messages-with-ai/) - Search WhatsApp chat history across messages, transcripts and extracted file text. Narrow a query by chat or date and open the conversation around a match.
- [Transcribe WhatsApp voice messages](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-voice-note-transcription/) - Transcribe WhatsApp voice messages with a local engine or an HTTP endpoint. Save transcripts beside the original messages and search for a spoken phrase.
- [Export a WhatsApp chat for AI search](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-chat-export-import/) - Export a WhatsApp chat for AI search with a TXT or ZIP file. Preview the conversation, confirm senders and dates, then import older history into WA MCP.
- [A free, self-hosted WhatsApp API](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/self-hosted-whatsapp-api/) - Run a free, self-hosted WhatsApp API for a linked personal account. Read messages through authenticated local endpoints and inspect the OpenAPI description.
- [Read chats with the WhatsApp MCP Python SDK](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-mcp-python/) - Use the WhatsApp MCP Python SDK to read a linked chat, inspect connection status, query encrypted history and download one attachment with the local bridge.
- [WhatsApp MCP security and account risk](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-mcp-security/) - See what WA MCP encrypts, what a connected assistant receives, how sending approval works and where to review alerts about a linked WhatsApp device.
- [Run WhatsApp MCP with Docker Compose](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-mcp-docker/) - Run WhatsApp MCP with Docker Compose and Caddy. Check the services, link a phone and back up the message volume, session and encryption key separately.
- [WhatsApp webhooks or an n8n AI workflow?](https://tsahospital-beep.github.io/wa-mcp/whatsapp-webhook-workflows/) - Compare WA MCP signed WhatsApp webhooks with the n8n Business Cloud node. Receive a live event, verify its signature and handle retries in your workflow.
